description.en-US: Four shorter pieces Newman published as a Catholic: Cathedra Sempiterna, a short Latin-titled note on the See of Peter (1867); On Consulting the Faithful in Matters of Doctrine, from the Rambler of 1859; Five Letters to his nephew John Rickards Mozley (1875), in defence of the Catholic position; and On the Inspiration of Scripture, the Nineteenth Century essays of 1884.
description.pt-BR: Quatro escritos menores que Newman publicou como católico: Cathedra Sempiterna, breve nota sobre a Sé de Pedro (1867); Sobre a Consulta aos Fiéis em Matéria de Doutrina, do Rambler de 1859; Cinco Cartas ao sobrinho John Rickards Mozley (1875), em defesa da posição católica; e Sobre a Inspiração da Escritura, os ensaios do Nineteenth Century de 1884.

en-US.editor: John Henry Newman (Newman Reader transcriptions of the Rambler, the Nineteenth Century and the Contemporary Review texts)

sources.edition: Cathedra Sempiterna (Dublin Review/Weekly Register 1867); On Consulting the Faithful in Matters of Doctrine (Rambler, July 1859); Five Letters to J. R. Mozley (Contemporary Review, Sept. 1899); On the Inspiration of Scripture (Nineteenth Century, Feb. and May 1884), as transcribed by the Newman Reader.
sources.description: 5 chapters: Newman Reader page numbers, navigation and its editorial remarks are dropped; Newman's own notes are kept as footnotes. Each piece is its own Newman Reader page. The index URL above is the first page; the others are miscellaneous/jrmozley.html, miscellaneous/scripture.html and rambler/consulting.html. Raw page text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Public domain: Newman died in 1890 and the text is of a Longmans impression (or earlier edition) before 1930. The Newman Reader page footers claim copyright in the site's transcription (c) 2007 NINS; a plain transcription of a public-domain text adds no authorship under US law.
